en.title: The Autumn Promotion only requires 8.4 of "FireWire Miami", why is it that people are reluctant to close the game even after death?

First of all, exclude "Dig to Survive with Benny Ford". It is indeed difficult, but the vast majority of people will choose to leave after red temperature. Secondly, games like "Limbo", "Inside", and "Braid" are difficult to solve puzzles and can tell a good story, but there are fewer opportunities to pick them up after completing the level. If I could only recommend one, I would definitely recommend the 2012 classic "Hotline Miami". As a very old top-down shooting game, its victory conditions are surprisingly strict: you only have one life at a time, and then defeat all enemies. There are more than 5 million players in this series. en.title: The search-and-defeat game “PUBG: Blackland Evacuation” announced the suspension of development

The development team would like to express its gratitude to all players who participated in the closed beta and provided feedback.
